title: Whoop snap track
description: A full-bleed horizontal card track that snaps card by card (to the start or the centre), lines its first card up with the page column, lets the next card peek, and shows small round dots that follow the scroll and jump to a card when clicked.
notes: native scroll-snap, no carousel library; the dots need JavaScript (hydrate visible)
turn it into a grid at a breakpoint with trackClassName (e.g. lg:grid lg:grid-cols-3) and hide the dots with dotsClassName
name: whoop-snap-track

props.name: slideClassName
props.description: classes for each slide wrapper: its width (e.g. "w-[20.8rem]")

props.name: align
props.description: start: cards snap to the page column's left edge · center: cards snap to the middle (neighbours peek both sides)

props.name: start
props.description: the card shown first (scrolled to once the page runs)

props.name: dotLabel
props.description: screen-reader name of each dot, followed by its number ("Show card" → "Show card 2")

props.name: tone
props.description: light: black dots for white bands · dark: white dots for black bands

props.name: showDots
props.description: show the dots under the track (default true)

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: told whenever the current card changes

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: extra classes for the scrolling row (gap, or a grid at a breakpoint)

props.name: dotsClassName
props.description: extra classes for the dots row (e.g. "lg:hidden")
